card.name: Words just before dialysis in kidney patients
card.fires_on: Small words such as on, requiring, by or maintenance that come right before dialysis or hemodialysis, usually after end stage renal disease or CKD patients.

modes.label: On dialysis
modes.description: The word on links kidney patients to dialysis treatment.
